title: When the Terminal Burns
author: Gideon Quintana
blurb: Astrid Joubert, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
